A command-line light wallet for Zcash. Runs the given command and exits, or starts the interactive prompt when given none.

Usage: zingo-cli.exe [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  addresses               List unified addresses in the wallet.
  balance                 Return the wallet ZEC balance for each pool (account 0).
  birthday                Returns block height wallet was created
  calculate               Sign the latest proposal without transmitting it.
  change_server           Change indexer server
  check_address           Checks if the given encoded address is derived by the wallet's keys.
  clear                   Clear the wallet state, rolling back the wallet to an empty state.
  coins                   Show the wallet's coins (transparent outputs).
  confirm                 Build and transmit the latest proposal, then resume sync.
  current_price           Updates and returns current price of ZEC.
  delete                  Delete wallet file from disk
  drain                   Send all Orchard funds into the Ironwood pool now (immediate ZIP 318 path).
  export_ufvk             Export unified full viewing key for the wallet.
  height                  Print the chain height as of the wallet's last request to the server.
  help                    Lists all available commands
  info                    Get the indexer server's info
  max_send_value          Print the most the wallet can send to a given address.
  memobytes_to_address    Show by address memo_bytes transfers for this seed.
  messages                List memos for this wallet.
  migrate                 Migrate all Orchard funds to the Ironwood pool in one interactive run.
  migration               Drive the scheduled Orchard to Ironwood migration
  network                 Control the network posture and mixnet transport; `network on` switches an unconsented offline session to ONLINE MODE.
  new_address             Create a new unified address.
  new_taddress            Create a new transparent address.
  new_taddress_allow_gap  Create a new transparent address (even if the last one did not receive any funds).
  notes                   Show the wallet's notes (shielded outputs).
  parse_address           Parse an address
  parse_viewkey           Parse a view_key.
  quicksend               Send ZEC, fusing `send` and `confirm`.
  quickshield             Shield transparent funds, fusing `shield` and `confirm`.
  quit                    Quit the light client, saving state to disk.
  recovery_info           Print the wallet's seed phrase, birthday and account count.
  remove_transaction      Remove a failed transaction from the wallet.
  rescan                  Clear all chain-derived wallet data and sync again from the birthday.
  save                    Launch the save task. Not meant to be called by hand.
  send                    Propose a transfer of ZEC, for 'confirm' to transmit.
  send_all                Propose a transfer of all shielded ZEC to one address, for 'confirm' to transmit.
  sends_to_address        Show by address number of sends for this seed.
  servers                 Show ranked indexer servers and response times
  settings                Show or set wallet settings.
  shield                  Propose a shield of transparent funds, for 'confirm' to transmit.
  spendable_balance       Display the wallet's spendable balance.
  split                   Split Orchard notes into ZIP 318 part sizes, one round per call.
  sync                    Sync the wallet to the latest state of the blockchain.
  t_addresses             List transparent addresses in the wallet.
  transactions            List the wallet's transaction summaries by block height.
  transmit                Transmit calculated transactions to the Indexer.
  value_to_address        Show by address value transfers for this seed.
  value_transfers         List all value transfers for this wallet.
  version                 Get version of build code
  wallet_kind             Displays the kind of wallet currently loaded

Options:
  -n, --nosync               By default, zingo-cli will sync the wallet at startup. Pass --nosync to prevent the automatic sync at startup.
      --waitsync             Block execution of the specified command until the background sync completes. Has no effect if --nosync is set.
  -c, --chain <CHAIN>        What chain to expect. One of "mainnet", "testnet", or "regtest". Defaults to "mainnet"
  -s, --seed <SEED PHRASE>   Create a new wallet with the given 24-word seed phrase. Will fail if wallet already exists. A seed passed here is visible in this host's process list and shell history; export ZINGO_SEED instead to keep it to this process and its child.
      --viewkey <UFVK>       Create a new wallet with the given encoded unified full viewing key. Will fail if wallet already exists
      --birthday <birthday>  Specify wallet birthday when restoring from seed. This is the earliest block height where the wallet has a transaction. For a NEW wallet created in Offline mode it is instead an optional override of the library's built-in birthday floor.
      --server <server>      Pin a specific Indexer server. Without it, an online session's Server-Selection Sweep selects the sync indexer.
      --offline              Run the session in Offline mode: no Indexer is ever configured. Local operations (addresses, balances, history, proposing) work; sync, transmission, and server commands are unavailable.
      --online               Consent to go online this session (Connectivity Consent). First boot is offline by design; this flag, --remember-online, an explicit --server, or a stored standing consent takes a session online. The choice is not persisted.
      --remember-online      Consent to go online this session AND store the choice beside the wallet, so future sessions attach to the network automatically. Undo with --forget-online.
      --forget-online        Remove the stored standing Connectivity Consent before deciding this session's connectivity. Without another consent act the session then runs offline.
      --nym-proxy <PATH>     Path to the nym-proxy binary spawned for Mixnet Mode. Without it: $ZINGO_NYM_PROXY, then a nym-proxy bundled beside this binary, then `nym-proxy` on PATH. Used only with the `nym` build feature.
      --data-dir <data-dir>  Absolute path to use as data directory
      --log-file <PATH>      Path to the log file for interactive mode. Defaults to .zingo-cli/cli.log
  -h, --help                 Print help
  -V, --version              Print version
